Page.Title: Terminal
Page.Subtitle: Run local commands in the Monica host environment.

States.NoOutput: No retained output. Enter a command below.
States.NoSession: No terminal session is active. Create a session to continue.

Messages.OwnerStorageFailed: The browser session partition could not be saved. Retry before running commands.
Messages.RefreshFailed: Session refresh failed. Previously accepted evidence is retained: {0}

History.Scope: Latest {0} of {1} retained commands. Selecting a command copies it into the draft.
History.Empty: No retained commands in this session.

Behavior.Title: How commands run
Behavior.Shell: Each command starts a fresh shell without interactive input. Shell variables and environment changes reset after each command.
Behavior.Directory: Use the dedicated cd command to change this session’s working directory. Compound shell commands do not update the retained directory.
Behavior.Lifetime: Sessions and output remain in host memory until closed or the host restarts. An accepted command continues when you leave this page. Cancellation does not undo applied effects.
Behavior.Partition: This browser identifier groups retained sessions. It does not authenticate a user or authorize command execution.

Input.Helper: Shell state resets after each command. Use cd to change this session’s directory.
